description: This map shows a schematic representation of a typical coastal lagoon landscape, illustrating the spatial distribution of various land cover types. The legend on the right indicates six distinct classes by colour. Starting from inland areas: "2.1.1 Arable irrigated and non-irrigated land" is depicted in light green and a very light beige. Adjacent to the lagoon and along the coast, "3.2.1 Other natural & semi-natural coniferous forest" appears in medium green, and "5.3 Sclerophyllous scrub" in an olive green. The central water body is classified as "8.3.1 Lagoons" (light blue). This lagoon is separated from the "8.4.2 Coastal waters" (also light blue) by a narrow land barrier of "6.2.1 Beaches and Dunes" (yellow). To the far right, beyond the coastal waters, a darker blue area likely represents the open "Sea and ocean". Yellow arrows originating from the land barrier point towards the open sea, suggesting coastal processes or transitions. The diagram visually supports the classification guidelines for coastal features within a broader land monitoring framework.
